taxes.statute: Constituição art. 150 I; Const. art. 153 VII
taxes.why: Not levied (convention R5-3k-G, pass 12): Constituição art. 150 I: "exigir ou aumentar tributo sem lei que o estabeleça" (`br/law/const_art-150.md`); Constituição art. 153 VII: "grandes fortunas, nos termos de lei complementar" (`br/law/const_art-153.md`). The tax on grandes fortunas of art. 153 VII needs a lei complementar, which has not been enacted; no law read in this build levies a recurrent tax on net wealth (laws read include: Lei SP 6.374/1989 art. 34; Lei 10.637/2002 art. 2; Lei municipal 13.701/2003 art. 16; TIPI (Decreto 11.158/2022), RFB consolidated table updated to ADE RFB 5/2026 (no chapter 22 or 24 change noted after 2022): 2202.10.00 / 2202.99.00 2,6 %; Decreto 7.212/2010 art. 212-B (Decreto 12.127/2024); Lei 10.336/2001 art. 5).
